name: @algorythmo/brain-cli
description: GBrain CLI dependency for Algorythmo Brain MVP (M3). Managed separately from the frontend bundle.

notes.pin-policy: ADR-0013 — pin by 40-char commit SHA, bump bi-weekly (odd ISO week Mondays) + hotfix lane for CVE/regression. Replace SHA_TO_BE_PINNED_DAY0 with the actual 40-char SHA before merging PR M3-1.
notes.runtime: Managed via bun. Run `bun install` in engines/algorythmo/ to install. The gbrain CLI binary is invoked via Open3 subprocess from Brain::Client (PR M3-2).
